name: council
description: Convene agency-agents specialists on one open decision, including architecture selection when a draft exists and the goal is to choose rather than edit. Incumbent-draft mode adopts a neutral brief, runs blind challenger search, then reveals and compares the draft. Canonical Claude records may reach CONVERGED; weaker runs return unaudited, non-authorizing ADVISORY. Use review-loop to fix artifacts to APPROVE. Requires ~/.agency-agents.
